text:
lily: Dropping a micro-proposal for trace exports in the drilldown: include a small manifest inside the zip (manifest.json) with a short summary (trace_id, span_count, size_estimate, scrubbed_fields) and surface a signed-download URL in the Downloads panel. Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1769456780.png
ben: I like manifest idea. Backend notes: we can compute size_estimate async; manifest can include job_id and signed_url TTL. Need to be explicit about fields in manifest to satisfy compliance: `scrubbed_fields` should be an array. Example manifest: {
  "trace_id": "abcd...",
  "spans": 234,
  "size_bytes_est": 1234567,
  "scrubbed_fields": ["headers"],
  "job_id": "job_123"
}
megan: UX: surface the manifest summary in the export modal before submit: show "Estimated size: ~1.2 MB" and "Contains: spans, events, optional request bodies". Add a small checkbox "Include request bodies" (unchecked by default) that updates estimate. Also show an explicit note: "Signed URL valid for 7 days".
aria: Accessibility checklist: export modal needs role=dialog, trap focus, and all checkboxes should have clear labels. For the manifest we should expose the scrubbed_fields as readable text: "Sensitive fields removed: headers, cookies". Provide a button "View manifest" which opens a keyboard-focusable code block with `role=document` and copy button. When copy succeeds announce via aria-live: "Export manifest copied to clipboard".
lily: Question on copy affordance: should the copy action on the manifest copy the entire manifest JSON or a short permalink to the job? I'm leaning to both: small "Copy link" and separate "Copy manifest JSON" for support.
ben: Both is fine. Permalink example: `/downloads/job_123?token=eyJ...` — server generates a short token. For large-org security we should require manager approval if `include_request_bodies=true`. Add an API flag `requires_approval` to manifest.
megan: Microcopy: modal header "Export trace data"; primary CTA "Start export"; secondary "Cancel". After start show toast "Export queued — we will notify you when ready" and put the job in Downloads panel. Downloads row should show progress %, estimated size, and a small kebab with "Copy link" and "Delete export".
aria: Color/contrast: make the progress badge use a dark accent (>=4.5:1). Small inline copy buttons should be at least 44px touch target or have an explicit focus ring. For the manifest code block ensure monospace font and 16px min for readability when keyboard-focused.
ops-bot: Note: export endpoints rate-limited to 3/min per org. Background job endpoints: `POST /api/exports` returns `{job_id, estimated_size, requires_approval}`. Signed URLs expire in 7 days.
lily: Decision draft: - Include manifest.json inside export zip. - Modal shows estimate + scrub checkbox. - Provide both "Copy link" and "Copy manifest JSON". - Require approval flag for request bodies. I'll update mock to show the Downloads panel row with progress and copy actions.
megan: Also add telemetry event `export_initiated` with fields: org_id, user_id, scope, estimated_size, requires_approval. Good for support.
aria: Small copy tweak: use "correlation identifier" in tooltips and avoid shorthand "ID".
ops-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood.design/previews/1769456780  feedback window 48h :calendar:
